notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first search result matched the expected slug (a-way-out-2018); RAWG's description says the game cannot be played alone, only in split-screen or online co-op. Steam app 1222700 was the only exact app-list match. 8 of 14 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; several have low unlock rates (for example "Managed Anger" 3.0%, "Timeless Treasure" 3.6%, "Take A Breather" 3.7%), so they may be optional moments rather than plain story. The visible six are split into three small chapters by theme; the data gives no chapter or act names. StrategyWiki has "A Way Out" at completion stage 0, marked as a stub; its Gameplay, Walkthrough, Table of Contents and Custom Nav subpages are linked but not written, so nothing was used. On awayout.fandom.com the API returns a page titled "A Way Out" but with 0 linked articles, so the wiki looks nearly empty; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
